title: bug: a launch outage carried into a verified-local iteration never ends: the VM route turns every launch probe into a no-launch while the outage suppresses every claim (moe-agent.sh)
description:
Found while planning task-1ccae85c. It is the residual of QA hand-forward comment-87cd53fd (b) on CQ-M07m (task-828e7d21).

Since M07m, a VM-route iteration never ENTERS a launch outage (scripts/moe-agent.sh:11953 gates outage entry on VM_ROUTE != true). But LAUNCH_OUTAGE is wrapper-process state, and the readiness gate re-reads the profile on every iteration.

Repro:
1. A legacy-profile bash worker seat reaches 3 fast launch failures, so LAUNCH_OUTAGE=true and the held task is released.
2. The project flips to verified-local (ready) while that wrapper process lives.
3. On the next iteration VM_ROUTE=true and the seat VM starts. The claim is suppressed (~:10022, outage with nothing held).
4. The taskless decision sets LAUNCH_PROBE=true and prints `MOE_LAUNCH_PROBE ... launching a taskless launch probe` (~:11037). The VM block then turns that probe into a no-launch (`reason=vm-route`).
5. MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH leaves the streak and the outage as they were (~:11923). Only a launch that runs clears the outage (~:11985), so the seat never claims again. It idles until a hot reload or relaunch resets the shell state.

Fix direction (the planner decides): a VM-route iteration does not honour a carried-over outage, because outage mode is a host-CLI concept and the VM route has its own job-failure budget. Either clear the outage state when the route engages, or skip the outage claim-suppression and the probe on the route. Also, print MOE_LAUNCH_PROBE only when a probe actually launches. Legacy launches and outage handling must stay byte-identical.

Test needs a mid-run readiness flip. The shared fixture scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js answers FAKE_READINESS from env only, so it needs an additive knob that is inert when unset. The PowerShell twin follows CQ-M07n (task-62ec51f1), which mirrors M07m's outage exemption.
definitionOfDone: A bash verified-local iteration that starts in a launch outage carried over from a legacy iteration claims again, launches no host CLI, and prints no MOE_LAUNCH_PROBE line.
Legacy launch-outage behavior and diagnostics are byte-identical; the existing postflight.sh launch-outage rows pass unchanged.
A postflight-vm-route.sh row flips readiness mid-run (legacy outage, then verified-local) and asserts the claim resumes; focused wrapper rows and parity-check pass.
